meta.title: DSE English Learn Mode Practice Bank
meta.subject: DSE english
meta.note: Practice sets for the /dse/english/learn course, plus original reading, writing, listening and speaking drills. Written for teaching; not HKEAA past-paper material. The learn-mode-1 bank remains the first 128 items; later ids extend the same topic keys.

questions.question: Passage: “The new library opens at 9 a.m. on weekdays, but at 11 a.m. on Sundays.” According to the passage, when does the library open on Sundays?
options: A. At 9 a.m.
B. At 11 a.m.
C. It does not open on Sundays.
D. The passage does not say.
questions.explanation: 這是定位題：答案明寫在文章內，關鍵詞是 Sundays，對應句子的後半部分 but at 11 a.m.。前面的 9 a.m. on weekdays 是干擾資訊，只適用於平日。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Passage: “Waste has been cut by half since the scheme began.” Which option best expresses the same meaning?
options: A. The scheme has stopped producing waste.
B. The amount of rubbish has dropped by 50%.
C. Waste has doubled since the scheme started.
D. The scheme was cancelled halfway.
questions.explanation: 考評局的題目習慣用同義改寫。cut by half 等於減少一半，即 dropped by 50%。選項 A、C、D 都改變了原文意思，屬典型的字面誤讀。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 你已經確定第 5 題的答案在第二段。第 6 題的答案最可能在邊個位置？
options: A. 第一段
B. 第二段之前的任何一段
C. 第二段或第三段
D. 最後一段
questions.explanation: 卷一題目編號大致跟文章段落順序推進。如果第 5 題在第二段，第 6 題通常在同一段或下一段，很少會跳回第一段。若發現自己往回跳，通常代表前一題搵錯位置。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 題目：“Give two reasons why the writer thinks online learning is not suitable for everyone. (4 marks)” 邊種寫法最有效？
options: A. 寫一段總論，說明 online learning 有好有壞
B. 分兩點寫，每點一句結論加一句文中支持
C. 把文章相關段落整段抄一次
D. 寫四點，把同一理由用不同字眼重複
questions.explanation: 長題目通常是 point-based marking：4 分代表兩個獨立要點，每點要有結論與支持。A 太籠統、C 屬搬字過紙、D 重複同一點只計一次。分點寫讓評卷員快速找到得分點。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 題目後面寫住 “(paragraph 3)”，這個括號的作用是？
options: A. 提示答案在第三段，直接去該段搵料
B. 說明該題目佔 3 分
C. 要求你只讀第三段便能回答全份卷
D. 表示該段可以跳過
questions.explanation: 段落編號是出題人給的位置提示，可以直接縮窄搜尋範圍。忽略括號等於自己增加難度，白白浪費時間。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 題目用 “reduce plastic use”，文章寫 “cut down on single-use items”。你應該點做？
options: A. 只搜尋 reduce 這個字，搵唔到就跳到下一題
B. 搜尋同義表達，例如 cut down on、fewer、less
C. 認定題目與文章無關，選 the passage does not say
D. 只讀第一段就算
questions.explanation: 出題人刻意改用同義詞或改寫，字面唔同不代表位置唔對。定位題搵的是「意思」，所以要搜尋整組近義表達，而唔係單一字眼。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 以下邊一種答案形式最符合閱讀卷的評分要求？
options: A. 完整抄回原文句子，確保意思準確
B. 只寫一個關鍵名詞，愈短愈好
C. 用自己嘅字詞改寫，並包含題目要求的全部要點
D. 寫一段個人評論，講自己對該議題的看法
questions.explanation: 評卷看的是理解後的改寫（paraphrase）＋ 要點完整。抄原文通常不給分，只寫一個名詞會因資料不完整失分，寫個人評論則屬離題。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 做定位題的第一步應該是？
options: A. 先讀全文並背下所有細節
B. 先抽題目關鍵詞，再回文章掃描對應位置
C. 先估答案，再用文章確認
D. 先做長題目，最後才做定位題
questions.explanation: 定位題考「搵料」，方法很機械：抽關鍵詞、回文章掃描。先讀全文再答題會浪費時間，先估答案容易被自己的印象帶錯方向。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 卷一有 90 分鐘，你在 Part A 用了 55 分鐘。最合理的做法是？
options: A. 繼續慢慢做，Quality 比速度重要
B. 立即轉做 Part B，之後有剩時間才回頭補 Part A
C. 放棄 Part B，把時間全部用來檢查 Part A
D. 加快速度但唔改變做題次序
questions.explanation: Part A 通常較短較直接，理應 40 分鐘內完成。超過 45 分鐘就要轉去 Part B，因為長題目一樣逐分計，但組織需要更多時間。等到最後才發現長題目未開始，是最常見的卷一失分模式。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 關於卷一選答 Part B1 或 B2，以下邊一項描述正確？
options: A. B1 較易，選 B1 對拉高整體等級最有利
B. 做 B1 的考生最高只可達 Level 4
C. B1 與 B2 的分數比重不同，B2 佔更多分
D. 考生可以同時做 B1 與 B2，取較高分者
questions.explanation: 根據考評局的評核框架，B1 與 B2 各佔全科 10%，比重相同，但做 Part B1 的考生最高只可達 Level 4。程度中上的同學應該直接操 B2，避免自己封頂。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Passage: “My grandfather still keeps the old radio on the shelf, though nobody has switched it on for over a decade.” What can be inferred about the grandfather?
options: A. He listens to the radio every night.
B. He keeps the radio for sentimental reasons rather than for use.
C. He cannot afford a new radio.
D. He wants to repair the radio.
questions.explanation: 文中細節有兩個：仍然保留（still keeps）＋ 十多年冇開過。由兩者推論，收音機對他有紀念價值。A 與文中事實矛盾；C、D 文章完全冇線索——推論必須有文本根據。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Passage: “The new app promises to change how students revise. It is a bold claim, though one cannot help wondering how many will abandon it by the second week.” The writer's tone is best described as —
options: A. enthusiastic
B. sarcastic
C. cautious and sceptical
D. completely indifferent
questions.explanation: 讓步結構 “It is a bold claim, though…” 加上含蓄疑問 “one cannot help wondering” 表示保留與質疑，屬 cautious / sceptical。文中冇挖苦或反諷的語言特徵，所以唔係 sarcastic；亦冇熱情支持的措辭。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: “Are we really expected to believe that?” 這句話的主要功能是？
options: A. 提出疑問，等待對方提供資料
B. 表達質疑或批評的立場
C. 表示自己唔明白題目
D. 純粹的讚美
questions.explanation: 這是反問句（rhetorical question），形式是問句但功能是表態。考生遇到反問句要理解為作者表達質疑或批評，而唔係真的在提問。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Passage: “City officials have finally decided to address the housing problem.” What does “address” mean in this context?
options: A. To write an address on a letter
B. To deal with or tackle the problem
C. To speak formally to the problem
D. To ignore the problem
questions.explanation: 這是典型的熟詞僻義。受詞是 problem、主語是 officials，搭配之下 address 的意思是「正視、處理」，等同 deal with / tackle。用字典第一個解釋（地址）會完全唔通。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 以下邊一個答案屬於有效的推論？題目問 “What can be inferred about the writer's attitude towards the scheme?”
options: A. He thinks the scheme is a complete waste of money.
B. He welcomes the scheme's aims but doubts whether it can be enforced.
C. Most people in Hong Kong dislike the scheme.
D. The scheme will be cancelled next year.
questions.explanation: 有效推論要緊扣文本的證據結構，B 對應文中「肯定目的、質疑執行」的讓步寫法。A 是過度的絕對判斷，C 把文章範圍擴大到全港市民，D 是對未來的無根據預測——三者都超出文中線索。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 作者連續三次用 “Again and again, we were told…” 這種句式的效果是？
options: A. Repetition 強調重複發生的經驗，帶出不耐煩或無奈的語氣
B. 表示作者記性唔好
C. 純粹為了增加字數
D. Metaphor，把說話比喻成雨
questions.explanation: 語言特徵題答題公式是：指出手法（repetition）＋ 強調什麼（重複的經驗）＋ 對讀者的效果（感受到不耐煩或無奈）。只寫「令文章生動」太籠統，評卷唔會視為完整答案。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Passage: “She did not complain, even though the shift lasted twelve hours. She simply wrote her report and left.” What can be inferred?
options: A. She was lazy at work.
B. She was patient and uncomplaining.
C. She enjoyed writing reports more than anything else.
D. She planned to resign immediately.
questions.explanation: 證據是 did not complain 與 simply wrote her report and left——由「不抱怨、照做事」可以推出她沉默而具耐性。C 與 D 文章冇線索，屬於自己補故事。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 做語氣題（tone）時，最應該留意邊樣？
options: A. 文章中出現的所有數字
B. 作者的評價詞與句子的形式（反問、讓步）
C. 文章的長度
D. 題目有幾多分
questions.explanation: 語氣由評價詞（brilliant、ridiculous、overrated）與句式（反問、讓步結構）共同決定。捉這些線索比憑感覺揀選項穩定得多，而且判斷要以作者整體立場為準。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Passage: “The company had to bear the full cost of the recall.” What does “bear” mean here?
options: A. To carry a heavy animal
B. To accept and pay for something
C. To give birth to
D. To run away from
questions.explanation: bear 的常見意思是「熊／忍受」，但在 bear the cost 這個搭配中是「承擔、負擔」。判斷方法是用上下文與搭配：受詞是 cost，主語是公司，所以是承擔費用的意思。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 以下邊一句唔可以作為推論題的答案？
options: A. He keeps the tickets because they remind him of that summer.
B. She probably felt nervous, as she kept checking her watch.
C. Everyone in Hong Kong agrees with this policy anyway.
D. He values the letters more than the money.
questions.explanation: C 的「全港所有人都同意」既冇文本根據，亦是無法由文章推出的普遍化斷言。其餘三項都能對應文章細節（提醒往事、反覆看錶、重視信件）。推論要有文本線索，唔可以靠常識或概括。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 根據卷二（Writing）的評核框架，Part A 與 Part B 的字數要求分別約為？
options: A. Part A 約 100 字，Part B 約 250 字
B. Part A 約 200 字，Part B 約 400 字
C. Part A 約 400 字，Part B 約 200 字
D. 兩部分都約 300 字
questions.explanation: 考評局的評核框架列明：Part A 是引導式短題目（約 200 字，佔 10%），Part B 是較開放式的長題目（約 400 字，四選一，佔 15%）。嚴重偏離字數會影響內容發展的評分。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 題目要求 “Write an article for your school magazine.” 以下邊一項格式處理正確？
options: A. 用 Dear Editor 開頭，Yours faithfully 結尾
B. 可以加一個標題，內文用段落推進，唔加書信稱呼
C. 一定要寫地點與日期在右上角
D. 文章必須用第一人稱單數並且唔可以有段落
questions.explanation: 文章（article）唔屬於書信格式，加 Dear Editor 或 Yours faithfully 屬語域與格式錯配，會影響 appropriacy 分。文章可加標題、分段推進，語域可 semi-formal 視刊物對象而定。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Part A 要求你以學生會主席身份寫信給校長。以下邊句語氣最合適？
options: A. Hey! We wanna add some water coolers, cool?
B. I am writing to propose installing water dispensers in the school campus.
C. Water dispensers are great, everyone will love it, no doubt.
D. Listen, we need water dispensers, please do it.
questions.explanation: 正式而有請求性質的書信應該用完整句式與中性語氣。A 的口語（Hey、wanna）與 C 的誇張斷言、D 的命令式語氣都唔符合與校長溝通的身份與語域，屬 appropriacy 失分。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Part A 題目列出四個 bullet points，你漏做其中一項。結果是？
options: A. 唔影響，只要總字數足夠就可以
B. 內容完整度是按項計分，缺一項等於直接失去該部分分數
C. 會由語言分補回
D. 只在字數不足時才扣分
questions.explanation: 引導式短題目的內容要求以 bullet points 為單位，缺一項就是明確的內容失分。落筆前應該先數清題目要求幾多項，寫完後逐項核對。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Part B 四題選一，選題應該用幾多時間？判斷標準是什麼？
options: A. 用 10 分鐘，揀最有深度的一題
B. 用 3 至 5 分鐘，揀自己講得出三個具體點子的一題
C. 用 15 分鐘，逐題寫一段測試可行性
D. 隨機揀一題，唔需要考慮
questions.explanation: 四題可以取得同等分數，所以選題標準是「我能否講出三個具體支持點」，而唔係題目聽起來有幾高深。選題時間控制在 3 至 5 分鐘，把時間留給寫作。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Part B 題目問 “Should schools ban smartphones?” 以下邊種寫法回應了題目要求？
options: A. 描述香港學生使用智能手機的現況與數據
B. 明確表態，並用兩至三個支持點解釋理由
C. 列出智能手機的發明歷史與功能
D. 只寫一段個人經歷，唔表態
questions.explanation: 題目用 should 提問，要求的是立場與論證。A 只描述現況、C 屬背景資料、D 冇回應題目動作，三者都屬內容離題，即使語言流暢亦會大幅失分。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 寫 Part B 之前，應該預留幾多分鐘列提綱？
options: A. 0 分鐘，直接落筆
B. 約 3 至 5 分鐘，寫立場與三個支持點
C. 約 20 分鐘，寫一份完整草稿
D. 約 15 分鐘，逐字抄題目
questions.explanation: 提綱只需數行：立場一句、三個支持點各一句、結尾方向一句。太長時間的計劃會擠壓寫作時間，完全冇提綱則容易段落重複或中途離題。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 約 400 字的 Part B 文章，最合適的段落安排是？
options: A. 一段到底，令論述更連貫
B. 引言 ＋ 三段主體 ＋ 結論，每段長度相若
C. 引言寫 150 字，主體一段 60 字，結論一句
D. 七至八段，每段一至兩句
questions.explanation: 四至五段是 400 字的自然結構，每段一個要點可支持 coherence 評分。一段到底會影響組織分；段落嚴重不均或過度碎片化同樣唔理想。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 題目要求寫一封 email 給同學，邀請他參加活動。以下邊句最符合語域？
options: A. I am writing to formally invite you to participate in the forthcoming event.
B. We're holding the event next Friday — fancy joining us?
C. Pursuant to our discussion, kindly revert to us at your earliest convenience.
D. You are hereby invited to attend the said function.
questions.explanation: 寫給同學的 email 屬非正式或半正式，縮寫與直接邀請最自然。A 與 C、D 過度正式，甚至屬商業書信用語，與讀者身份不符，會被視為語域錯配。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 卷二共有 2 小時，以下邊一種時間分配較合理？
options: A. Part A 30 分鐘完成約 200 字，其餘時間留給 Part B 的構思與寫作
B. Part A 用 60 分鐘精雕細琢，Part B 用 45 分鐘
C. 兩部分平均各 60 分鐘
D. 先寫 Part B，最後用 15 分鐘寫 Part A
questions.explanation: Part A 佔 10%，字數約 200 字；Part B 佔 15%，約 400 字並需要構思。把較多時間留給 Part B 較符合分數比重。Part A 花 60 分鐘而在佔分更重的部分趕稿，屬典型分配失誤。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 以下邊一句最適合作為一段的 topic sentence？
options: A. Many students use social media every day.
B. Social media should be taught as part of the school curriculum.
C. Social media was invented in the early 2000s.
D. My cousin is on social media.
questions.explanation: Topic sentence 必須是可辯論的主張。A、C、D 都只是描述事實，冇立場可以支持或反駁，所以帶唔起一段論證。B 提出 should，可以接上解釋與例子。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: PEE / PEEL 段落結構指的是？
options: A. Point — Explanation — Example（— Link）
B. Plan — Edit — End
C. Paragraph — Evidence — End
D. Point — Extract — Elaborate only
questions.explanation: PEE 是三件套：主張（Point）、解釋（Explanation）、例子（Example），PEEL 的最後 L 是連接下一段的 Link。這個結構確保每段都有推進，而唔係重複同一件事。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 以下哪句寫法錯誤，需要修正？
options: A. The trip was cancelled, we stayed home.
B. The trip was cancelled; we stayed home.
C. The trip was cancelled, so we stayed home.
D. Because the trip was cancelled, we stayed home.
questions.explanation: A 是 comma splice：兩個完整句子只用逗號連接。修法有三：用分號（B）、加連接詞（C）、或改成從屬結構（D）。結構錯是最影響閱讀的作文問題。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 「The scheme helps students save money and reducing waste.」這句話的問題是？
options: A. 平行結構不一致，reducing 應改為 reduce
B. 時態錯，should 改為 saved
C. 主謂不一致
D. 介詞錯，應改為 save on money for
questions.explanation: and 連接的兩個項目形式要一致：save 是原形，後面亦應是原形 reduce。“save money and reduce waste” 才符合平行結構。用 V-ing 混搭原形是常見的平行結構錯。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 以下哪一句屬有效的讓步（concession）？
options: A. Phones are useful, so schools should allow them.
B. Admittedly phones can be distracting, but a ban is hard to enforce.
C. Phones are bad and should be banned.
D. Everyone knows phones are useful.
questions.explanation: 讓步是「先承認對方論點有部分成立，再提出自己的立場」，用 admittedly、although、while、it is true that 這一類結構。B 先承認分心問題，再提出執行困難，顯示思考立體。A 只是因果，C 是單邊斷言，D 是訴諸普遍。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 要在段落之間顯示「這一點比上一點更重要」，最合適的銜接詞是？
options: A. For example
B. More importantly
C. In other words
D. Finally
questions.explanation: More importantly 表示遞進並強調重要性。For example 引出例子、In other words 是重述、Finally 表示順序結束，三者都唔表達「更重要」的比較關係。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 「Students should work part-time. Many students work part-time. Working part-time is good for students.」這段的主要問題是？
options: A. 三句講同一件事，段落冇推進
B. 時態不一致
C. 引用數據不足
D. 用字太深
questions.explanation: 三句只有一個意思，沒有解釋與例子，屬內容發展不足。用 PEE 重寫：主張（教會理財）＋ 解釋（要為支出負責）＋ 例子（兼職後開始記帳），段落才有推進。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 「Walking home from school, the rain started suddenly.」這句錯在邊度？
options: A. 分詞片語的主語與主句主語不一致（dangling modifier）
B. 時態錯，應改為 has started
C. from 應改為 to
D. 應改為被動語態
questions.explanation: Walking home 的隱含主語應該是人，但主句主語是 the rain，兩者不一致，形成 dangling modifier。修正：「Walking home from school, I was caught in the rain.」
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 以下哪一句是港式英文，需要修正？
options: A. Let's discuss the proposal.
B. Let's discuss about the proposal.
C. We should talk about the proposal.
D. The proposal needs discussion.
questions.explanation: discuss 是及物動詞，後面唔加 about。要保留 about 就改用 talk about。這類由中文直譯的錯誤（討論 about）是作文準確度的高頻扣分位。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 主體三段的排列次序，較有效的做法是？
options: A. 隨機排列，反正評卷唔看次序
B. 由最有說服力的點寫到最弱的點
C. 由最弱的點寫到最強的點，最後才交代立場
D. 三段都講同一個點，用不同例子加強
questions.explanation: 把最有力的論點放在前面，可以立即建立立場的可信度，亦避免評卷員讀到最後仍未見到最強理由。D 屬重複，會令內容發展分受損。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 題目寫明 “Write ONE word”，你寫了兩個字，意思正確。結果是？
options: A. 照樣給分
B. 因超出字數限制而不給分
C. 扣一分
D. 由考官酌情加分
questions.explanation: 筆試的填空題字數限制是硬性要求，超過字數即使意思正確亦不給分。做卷時要養成先看限制的習慣，例如 ONE word 的答案通常是最直接的關鍵詞。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 題目：「The workshop will be held in the ______ on 15 June.」錄音：「Unfortunately the library is closed for renovation, so the workshop on 15 June will take place in the multi-purpose room instead.」答案應為？
options: A. library
B. renovation
C. multi-purpose room
D. 15 June
questions.explanation: 錄音先提到 library，但隨即用 unfortunately 與 instead 推翻，最終地點是 multi-purpose room。這題示範兩個原則：唔好聽到第一個相關名詞就填；要靠轉折詞判斷最終資訊。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 錄音播到一半你聽唔到一個關鍵詞。最合理的處理是？
options: A. 停低回想，直到想清楚為止
B. 先用縮寫或近似音記低，繼續聽下一段，最後再補
C. 立即跳過整份卷的該部分
D. 舉手問監考員
questions.explanation: 錄音唔會停，停一秒就漏後面的內容。正確做法是先記縮寫或近似音，繼續跟住錄音，最後有時間才回頭補。漏一題只損失少數分數，慌亂會連累整部分。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Part B 寫作任務要用 Data File 的資料，以下邊種做法最符合評分要求？
options: A. 整句原文照抄，確保資料準確
B. 抽取必要資料並改寫成自己的句式，配合任務格式
C. 完全唔用 Data File，只憑自己的想像寫
D. 抄錄 Data File 全部內容，字數越多越好
questions.explanation: 綜合任務要求選取、整合並改寫。整句照抄會影響語言分，完全唔用資料則無法完成任務，全部搬入卷則浪費時間並可能離題。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 任務寫明 “Write an email to your teacher.” 你若寫成一份 memo 格式，會出現什麼問題？
options: A. 冇問題，內容一樣就得
B. 屬格式與語域錯配，影響 appropriacy 評分
C. 只會扣發音分
D. 只會影響字數計算
questions.explanation: 卷三的任務格式是評分項目：email 要有稱呼與署名，報告要有標題與分節。唔跟指定格式屬 appropriacy 失分，即使內容完整亦會扣分。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 卷三約兩小時，以下邊一種時間安排較合理？
options: A. 聆聽部分約 50 至 55 分鐘，其餘留給 Part B 的綜合任務與延伸寫作
B. 聆聽部分用 90 分鐘慢慢核對
C. 先寫完綜合任務，最後才聽錄音
D. 全部時間平均分給兩部分，唔需要特別安排
questions.explanation: Part A 與 Part B 各佔 15%，但 Part B 需要整合資料與寫作，較耗時。一般建議聆聽部分用約 50 至 55 分鐘，剩餘時間留給需要組織語言的任務。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 錄音播放前，讀題時間最應該用來做什麼？
options: A. 背誦整份卷的答案格式
B. 圈出題目關鍵詞，並判斷答案類型（數字、人名、時間、原因）
C. 先寫好答案框架
D. 閱讀 Data File 全部內容並抄一次
questions.explanation: 先圈關鍵詞與判斷答案類型，可以在聽的時候知道要捕捉什麼，命中率明顯提高。抄寫 Data File 或預寫答案都唔是有效率的使用方法。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 錄音中的重複資訊通常代表什麼？
options: A. 說話者唔記得自己講過
B. 通常是題目要你填的關鍵資訊，值得優先記低
C. 錄音出錯，可以忽略
D. 表示後面一定有一樣的答案
questions.explanation: 錄音在短時間內再次提及同一項資訊，通常就是題目要考的關鍵詞，出題人刻意讓考生有第二次捕捉的機會。所以在讀題時可以先在題目紙標記「可能要聽兩次」的欄位。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 卷三 Part A 與 Part B 分別佔英文科總分的幾多？
options: A. 各佔 10%
B. 各佔 15%
C. Part A 20%、Part B 10%
D. 兩部分合共 20%
questions.explanation: 根據考評局的評核框架，卷三整體佔 30%，其中 Part A 與 Part B（B1 或 B2）各佔 15%。與卷一不同，卷三的兩部分比重相同。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 任務要求「提出一項建議」，但 Data File 完全冇提到建議。最可能的情況是？
options: A. 題目出錯，可以直接略過該項
B. 建議通常來自錄音，聽的時候要特別留意說話者提出的提示或提醒
C. 應該自己創作一項建議即可
D. 只有 Part B2 才會要求建議
questions.explanation: Part B 的設計是錄音與 Data File 互補：書面資料提供事實（價目、日期），錄音提供意見、變更或建議。所以聽的時候要留意 suggests、recommends、make sure、remember to 這一類提示語。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 小組討論開始時，以下邊一句最適合用來開場？
options: A. Silence, waiting for someone else to start.
B. Shall we start with the first point on the leaflet?
C. I think the answer is B.
D. Can you repeat the question, sir?
questions.explanation: 開場要覆蓋題目要求並邀請他人加入。B 同時做到兩件事：指向第一項討論內容、用 we 邀請全組。沉默會浪費觀察時間，C 是 MCQ 式回答，D 並非小組討論的溝通策略。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 組員講完「義工服務可以幫人」之後你接話。以下邊一句最能顯示你聆聽並推進？
options: A. I agree. Volunteering is good.
B. Building on what you said, volunteering also helps us understand people from different backgrounds.
C. That is wrong.
D. Let's talk about something else.
questions.explanation: B 用 Building on… 明確引用前一位同學，然後加入新角度，同時顯示聆聽、連繫與推進。A 只是附和冇新增；C 打斷式否定影響互動；D 轉題等於放棄現有討論。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 討論中出現沉默，最適當的做法是？
options: A. 一直等到有人開口
B. 主動提供新角度，或點名邀請組員發表，例如 “What do you think, Kelly?”
C. 重複自己上一句
D. 提高聲量繼續講
questions.explanation: 交波（turn-giving）是小組討論的核心技巧。提供新角度或邀請他人，可以讓討論重新運轉；沉默、重複或壟斷都會拉低整組的互動表現。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 討論即將結束，以下邊一句是最恰當的收尾？
options: A. Okay, we have to stop now.
B. It seems we all agree that the scheme is useful, though we differ on who should pay for it.
C. I have nothing to add.
D. So, what is the answer?
questions.explanation: 收尾要總結共識與分歧，令整組的討論有結構感。A 只是程序句，C 是放棄發言，D 屬 MCQ 思維——小組討論唔存在單一標準答案。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 卷四小組討論的準備時間與討論時間分別是？
options: A. 準備 10 分鐘，討論約 8 分鐘（四人一組）
B. 準備 5 分鐘，討論 15 分鐘
C. 準備 20 分鐘，討論 20 分鐘
D. 冇準備時間，即場開始討論
questions.explanation: 根據考評局的評核框架，考生有 10 分鐘準備時間（可以寫筆記並在討論時參考），四人一組的討論約 8 分鐘，之後每人再獨立回應考官提問。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 個人回應環節，以下邊一種結構最實用？
options: A. 只講一句立場，唔需要理由
B. 立場句 ＋ 兩個理由 ＋ 一個例子或讓步
C. 背一段事先寫好的 400 字短文
D. 連續講三個問題反問考官
questions.explanation: 個人回應約 30 至 45 秒最適中，結構包含立場、理由與例子或讓步，可以同時滿足內容、組織與語言的評分需求。背稿會因為題目即場才知而答非所問。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 以下邊種行為對小組討論最不利？
options: A. 回應組員的意見並補充
B. 由頭到尾自己講足全場，唔讓其他人發言
C. 望住組員聽他們說話
D. 主動提出一個新角度
questions.explanation: 小組討論評分觀察的是互動。壟斷發言會令其他組員無法發揮，整組的互動分與個人分同時受損。適度發言、主動交波才是最有效的策略。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 討論期間全程低頭看筆記，會影響邊方面的評分？
options: A. 唔會影響，筆記寫得越詳細越好
B. 眼神接觸與溝通表現，屬評分觀察項目之一
C. 只影響發音
D. 只影響語法準確度
questions.explanation: 評核框架列明考生要運用適當的語速、聲量、語調、眼神接觸與手勢支持溝通。筆記是輔助工具，用來瞄一眼而非全程照讀。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 回應完畢後加一句 “Sorry, my English is not good.” 會有什麼後果？
options: A. 顯示謙虛，會加分
B. 唔會加分，只會拉低整體印象
C. 會令考官重新評分
D. 可以爭取更多發言時間
questions.explanation: 自我貶抑唔是評分項目，反而會令考官對你的整體表現留下較弱印象。回應完畢直接停下即可，把注意力放在內容與清晰度上。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 個人回應講得太快（例如 15 秒講完三個理由），主要風險是？
options: A. 內容太少，發展不足
B. 咬字與重音變差，影響發音清晰度
C. 考官會以為你未準備
D. 以上 A 與 B 皆是
questions.explanation: 語速過快同時損害兩邊：一、內容未及發展，理由只是一句帶過；二、咬字與重音含糊，發音清晰度下降。適中語速（約 30 至 45 秒）可以兩邊兼顧。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Last summer I ______ a volunteer programme in Sai Kung.
options: A. join
B. joined
C. have joined
D. had joined
questions.explanation: Last summer 是已結束的過去時間標記，必須配過去式。現在完成式（have joined）唔可以與已結束的過去時間同用；had joined 需要另一個更早的過去事件作對照。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: By the time we arrived at the cinema, the film ______.
options: A. started
B. has started
C. had started
D. starts
questions.explanation: 「電影已開始」比「我們到達」更早，屬過去的過去，要用過去完成式 had started。用 started 會暗示兩件事同時發生，唔符合句意。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: I ______ in this neighbourhood for ten years, and I still like it here.
options: A. live
B. lived
C. have lived
D. had lived
questions.explanation: 由過去持續到現在（still like it here）的狀態用現在完成式 have lived，for ten years 是持續時間。lived 會表示已經唔再住；had lived 需要一個更早的參照時間。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: She ______ all morning, so she looks tired now.
options: A. revises
B. revised
C. has been revising
D. had revised
questions.explanation: 強調動作由過去持續到現在、可能仍未完成，用現在完成進行式 has been revising。句中 so she looks tired now 是「影響現在」的線索。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: A. The report finished by the committee yesterday.
B. The report was finished by the committee yesterday.
C. The report is finish by the committee yesterday.
D. The report finished by committee yesterday.
questions.explanation: 被動語態是 be + p.p.：was finished。A 漏 be 動詞（finish 亦冇過去分詞），C be 動詞形式錯，D 既漏 be 動詞亦漏冠詞。被動語態漏 be 是最常見的結構錯。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: If it ______ tomorrow, we will cancel the hiking trip.
options: A. rains
B. will rain
C. rained
D. would rain
questions.explanation: 第一類條件句表示真實可能的未來：從句用現在式，主句用 will。條件句的從句唔用 will，所以 If it will rain 是典型錯誤。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: If I ______ you, I would apply for the exchange programme.
options: A. am
B. was
C. were
D. will be
questions.explanation: 第二類條件句（與現在事實相反的假設）的 be 動詞傳統上用 were，即使主語是 I。主句用 would apply，與從句的過去式配套。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: If I had studied harder, I ______ the examination.
options: A. will pass
B. would pass
C. would have passed
D. had passed
questions.explanation: 第三類條件句表示與過去事實相反：從句 If + had + p.p.，主句 would have + p.p.。用 would pass 會變成與現在相反的假設，時間層次唔對。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Which sentence is incorrect?
options: A. The accident happened at midnight.
B. The accident was occurred at midnight.
C. The bridge was repaired last year.
D. The results have been announced.
questions.explanation: happen、occur、rise、arrive 屬不及物動詞，冇被動語態。B 的 was occurred 是錯的，應寫 The accident occurred at midnight. 這種「不及物動詞用被動」是常見錯誤。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: I have known him ______ 2019.
options: A. for
B. since
C. from
D. during
questions.explanation: since 接時間點（since 2019、since last June），for 接時間長度（for six years）。2019 是時間點，所以用 since，配現在完成式 have known。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: The list of items ______ still on the teacher's desk.
options: A. is
B. are
C. were
D. have been
questions.explanation: 真正的主語是 The list（單數），of items 只是修飾語。主謂一致要看主語核心字，唔可以被插入語騙到。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Every student in the form ______ required to submit the form.
options: A. are
B. is
C. were
D. have been
questions.explanation: every + 單數名詞（every student）配單數動詞 is。everyone、each、neither 這一類詞通常配單數動詞，是主謂一致的高頻考點。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Neither the teacher nor the students ______ informed about the change.
options: A. was
B. were
C. has been
D. is
questions.explanation: neither…nor 的原則是動詞跟最近的主語：the students 是複數，所以用 were。若改成 Neither the students nor the teacher，就要用單數 was。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: A. Please give me some informations about the course.
B. Please give me an information about the course.
C. Please give me some information about the course.
D. Please give me informations about the course.
questions.explanation: information 是不可數名詞，唔可以加 s 亦唔可以配 a / an。同類的還有 advice、equipment、furniture、research。這類錯在作文中很常見。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Which sentence uses articles correctly?
options: A. The education is important for everyone.
B. Education is important for everyone.
C. An education is important for everyone.
D. The educations are important for everyone.
questions.explanation: 抽象名詞在泛指情況唔加冠詞：Education is important。A 屬濫用 the，C 會指某一次特定的教育經驗，D 既加冠詞又誤用複數。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: She is very interested ______ marine biology.
options: A. on
B. in
C. at
D. for
questions.explanation: interested in 是固定搭配。介詞要靠搭配記憶，唔可以直譯中文的「對…有興趣」而寫 interested on。常見搭配還有 good at、depend on、responsible for。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Which is the best way to correct: “The trip was cancelled, we stayed home.”?
options: A. The trip was cancelled we stayed home.
B. The trip was cancelled; we stayed home.
C. The trip was cancelled, and but we stayed home.
D. The trip was cancelled. We stayed home, however we were sad.
questions.explanation: B 用分號正確分隔兩個完整句子，是修正 comma splice 的標準做法。A 直接連寫更錯，C 連接詞重複，D 又把 however 當連接詞（however 是副詞，前面應加分號或句號）。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Which of these is a sentence fragment?
options: A. Because the weather was bad.
B. The weather was bad.
C. Because the weather was bad, the match was postponed.
D. The match was postponed because of the weather.
questions.explanation: A 只有從屬子句，缺少主要子句，屬 fragment。加上主句（如 C）或用 B 的完整句才成立。寫作時唔應該讓 because、although、when 開頭的從屬子句獨立成句。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: A. My uncle, that lives in Macau, is visiting us.
B. My uncle that lives in Macau is visiting us, who is a doctor.
C. My uncle, who lives in Macau, is visiting us.
D. My uncle who lives in Macau, is visiting us.
questions.explanation: non-defining 關係子句要用逗號隔開，而且唔可以用 that 引導。A 用 that 錯，B 把關係子句錯掛在 us，D 的逗號位置造成主謂被錯誤分隔。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Which sentence has a dangling modifier?
options: A. Walking home from school, I saw a rare bird.
B. Walking home from school, the rain started.
C. Held last week, the exhibition attracted thousands.
D. Built in 1997, the bridge is now closed.
questions.explanation: Walking home 的隱含主語必須是人，但主句主語是 the rain，兩者不一致，形成 dangling modifier。A、C、D 的分詞片語主語都與主句主語一致，所以正確。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Which collocation is correct?
options: A. make homework
B. do homework
C. take homework
D. give homework
questions.explanation: 固定搭配是 do homework（做功課）。同類易錯的還有 make a decision（唔係 do a decision）、make a suggestion、achieve a goal。搭配冇通則，要按組合記憶。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 「我們需要盡快作出決定。」最自然的英文是？
options: A. We need to do a decision as soon as possible.
B. We need to make a decision as soon as possible.
C. We need to take a decision as soon as possible.
D. We need to give a decision as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: make a decision 是最通用的搭配。take a decision 屬英式較窄用法，do a decision 與 give a decision 唔自然。考試時應選最常見、最有信心的組合。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 「Please open the light.」應改為？
options: A. Please open up the light.
B. Please turn on the light.
C. Please switch the light.
D. Please start the light.
questions.explanation: 中文「開燈」直譯成 open the light 是典型港式英文。正確搭配是 turn on the light / switch on the light，關燈則是 turn off。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 「I very like this song.」應改為？
options: A. I very much like this song.
B. I like this song very much.
C. I am very like this song.
D. I like very this song.
questions.explanation: very 唔可以直接修飾動詞，唔可以放在 like 前面。最自然是把 very much 放在句尾：I like this song very much。這是中英句式差異造成的常見錯。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 「Please reply me as soon as possible.」應改為？
options: A. Please reply to me as soon as possible.
B. Please reply back me as soon as possible.
C. Please reply with me as soon as possible.
D. Please reply for me as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: reply 作「回覆某人」時要加 to：reply to me。respond 亦同樣加 to。reply back 雖然口語常見，但在正式寫作中屬冗餘，唔宜使用。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 「According to my opinion…」的修正方式是？
options: A. According to me opinion…
B. In my opinion…
C. According to my point of view…
D. On my opinion…
questions.explanation: according to 後面接的應該是外部資料來源（according to the report），唔可以接 my opinion。表達個人立場用 In my opinion 或 From my point of view。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 「The campaign was a great ______.」填入哪個詞正確？
options: A. succeed
B. success
C. successful
D. successfully
questions.explanation: a great 後面要接名詞：success。succeed 是動詞、successful 是形容詞、successfully 是副詞。詞形錯（word form）是寫作準確度的高頻失分位。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: “Cutting down on single-use plastic is the simplest way to reduce our carbon footprint.” 句中 carbon footprint 指？
options: A. 腳印的形狀
B. 個人或活動造成的碳排放總量
C. 郊野公園的步道
D. 腳部受傷的風險
questions.explanation: carbon footprint 是環保主題的核心詞，指個人、機構或活動所產生的溫室氣體總量。同一主題的常用詞還有 renewable energy、waste reduction、eco-friendly。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: “A sedentary lifestyle increases the risk of health problems.” 句中 sedentary 的意思最接近？
options: A. 經常運動的
B. 久坐少動的
C. 飲食不均衡的
D. 夜睡的
questions.explanation: sedentary lifestyle 指久坐少動的生活方式，是健康主題的高頻詞。寫建議時可配 cutting down screen time、daily exercise、standing breaks 等說法。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 「It is important for the society.」泛指社會時應改為？
options: A. It is important for the societies.
B. It is important for society.
C. It is important for a society.
D. It is important for the Society of Hong Kong.
questions.explanation: 泛指整體社會時，society 前唔加冠詞；加 the 通常指特定組織或已提及的社會。同類情況還有 the education、the pollution 這些濫用冠詞的寫法。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 英文科四卷在公開考試中所佔比重，由高至低正確排序是？
options: D. 四卷各佔 25%
questions.explanation: 根據考評局的評核框架：卷三 Listening & Integrated Skills 佔 30%，卷二 Writing 佔 25%，卷一 Reading 佔 20%，卷四 Speaking 佔 10%（四卷合共 85%，其餘 15% 為校本評核）。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 如果目標是 Level 5 或以上，卷一應該點安排？
options: A. 做 Part A 加 B1，穩陣取分
B. 做 Part A 加 B2，避免被 Level 4 封頂
C. 只做 Part B2
D. 兩邊都做，取較高分的一邊
questions.explanation: 做 Part B1 的考生最高只可達 Level 4。想取 Level 5 或以上就必須做 B2。考生唔可以兩邊都做或取較高分者，選卷在開考時就要決定。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 卷一閱讀的考試時間是？
options: A. 1 小時
B. 1 小時 30 分鐘
C. 2 小時
D. 約 2 小時 30 分鐘
questions.explanation: 卷一 Reading 為 1 小時 30 分鐘，佔 20%，Part A 與 Part B 各佔 10%。卷二 Writing 是 2 小時，卷三約 2 小時，卷四約 20 分鐘。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 卷二 Part A 的題目形式是？
options: A. 完全開放，冇任何提示
B. 引導式短題目，提供處境、目的與部分資料，約 200 字
C. 一篇 400 字的議論文的題目
D. 只要求填寫表格
questions.explanation: Part A 是 short guided task（約 200 字，佔 10%），提供處境、寫作目的與相關資料；Part B 才是較開放式的長題目（約 400 字，四選一，佔 15%）。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 「診斷式」使用 Past Paper 的意思是？
options: A. 只看分數，分數上升就繼續做新卷
B. 逐題標記錯因（詞彙、定位、答題格式、時間），再針對性練習
C. 把所有答案背下來
D. 只做最淺的年份
questions.explanation: 診斷式做法把「唔知點解錯」變成「知道要改什麼」：先標記錯因，再集中練同一類錯，兩星期後重測確認改善。只計分數會令同一類錯重複出現。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 同一份試卷做三次，比做三份新卷更有用的原因是？
options: A. 因為舊卷比較容易
B. 因為重做能暴露你固定重複的錯誤，也方便比較改善
C. 因為新卷冇參考答案
D. 因為做卷次數比分數重要
questions.explanation: 重做同一份卷時，你已經知道文章內容，所以錯的一定是技巧問題（定位、答題格式、時間），唔會再被「睇唔明文章」掩蓋。這樣才能確認練習是否有效。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 卷一自覺表現差，第二日要考卷二。最合理的處理是？
options: A. 當晚重做卷一並反覆對答案
B. 當晚改為準備卷二的提綱與檢查清單，唔再糾結卷一
C. 放棄卷二，專心準備下一次考試
D. 通宵背生字
questions.explanation: 四卷獨立計分，卷一的表現唔會改變卷二的分數。把當晚的時間用在可控制的準備（提綱、錯處清單）比反覆檢討已完成的卷更有效。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 卷二寫作完成後，最後幾分鐘最應該用來做什麼？
options: A. 重寫引言，令開頭更有文采
B. 檢查時態、介詞、冠詞與連接詞這幾類小錯
C. 增加一段新內容
D. 逐字抄一次全文
questions.explanation: 準確度評分受這些零碎錯誤影響最大，而且它們分散在全文，需要專門一輪檢查才捉得到。最後幾分鐘重寫引言或加新段落風險高、回報低。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 卷三你漏答了一題聆聽題目。最合理的處理是？
options: A. 停下來回想那題的答案
B. 繼續跟住錄音做後面的題目，最後有時間才回頭補
C. 放棄整份卷的該部分
D. 向監考員要求重播錄音
questions.explanation: 漏一題只損失一到兩分，但慌亂會連累整部分。錄音唔會重播，所以唯一有效的做法是保持跟進後面題目，最後有剩餘時間才回頭補。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 考前四至六星期的整合階段，最應該做的練習是？
options: A. 只做單項技巧練習，唔做完整卷
B. 每星期一份完整限時卷，練時間分配與狀態切換，做完即日核對
C. 集中背誦詞彙表
D. 只做最深的年份試題
questions.explanation: 整合階段的目標是把技巧在真實時間限制下串連起來，所以需要完整限時卷來練節奏與狀態切換。單項練習留給較早的針對性階段。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Passage: "Some volunteers stayed after the concert to stack chairs." Statement: "Every volunteer stayed to stack chairs." The statement is:
options: A. True
B. False
C. Not Given
D. True, because volunteers enjoy concerts
questions.explanation: some 證明唔到 every。文章亦冇講其餘義工有冇離開，所以唔係 False。D 用了文章以外的常識，Not Given 不可以靠卷外知識改成 True。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Passage: "The club cancelled the hike because the trail was closed. Members were told by email." Statement: "Members were disappointed about the cancellation." The statement is:
options: A. True
B. False
C. Not Given
D. True, because hikes are popular
questions.explanation: 文章只講取消原因同通知方法，冇講成員感受。感受合理並不足以當成 True。D 就係用常識補完。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Passage: "Mia lent her notes to Ben. This helped him catch up before the test." What does "This" refer to?
options: A. The test
B. Ben
C. Mia lending her notes to Ben
D. The notes, regardless of whether she lent them
questions.explanation: This 是單數，指前句整件事（把筆記借給 Ben）。test 是時間，Ben 是人，只寫 notes 會漏掉「借出」這個動作。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Passage: "Neither speaker supported the fee increase." Statement: "Both speakers opposed the fee increase." The statement is:
options: A. True
B. False
C. Not Given
D. True only for the first speaker
questions.explanation: Neither…supported 等於兩個人都不支持，同 both opposed 是同義改寫。意思一致就是 True，唔使逐個字相同，亦唔好因為換了詞就當 Not Given。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 正式信唔知道收信人姓名。正確配對是？
options: A. Dear Sir or Madam … Yours sincerely
B. Dear Sir or Madam … Yours faithfully
C. Dear Ms Chan … Yours faithfully
D. Hey … Best wishes, no name
questions.explanation: 姓名不詳用 Dear Sir or Madam 配 Yours faithfully。知道姓名（Dear Ms Chan）先用 Yours sincerely。題目如果另有指定格式，跟題目。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 題目要求 Write an article for the school magazine。邊樣會損 appropriacy？
options: A. 加一個標題
B. 用 Dear Principal 同 Yours sincerely，寫成一封信
C. 用短段落
D. 用一條問題做開頭
questions.explanation: 文章要有標題，唔加書信的 Dear 同結尾敬語。C 同 D 都符合 article。如果題目改為 letter，先使用 B 的格式。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 一篇 report 最合理的次序是？
options: A. 個人感受，然後先考慮要不要數據
B. Findings，然後 recommendations
C. 一句口號，沒有資料
D. Dear friends，然後一個表情符號
questions.explanation: 報告先交代發現，再寫建議。只寫感受或口號，內容同語域都會偏離任務。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Proposal 寫了問題、做法同好處，但冇寫需要校長批准什麼。最準確的判斷是？
options: A. 只影響拼字，內容分不受影響
B. 任務可能未完成，因為建議書通常要寫對方要做的決定
C. 建議書只需要講好處
D. 應改成交演講稿先算完成
questions.explanation: 建議書的讀者要知道你請他做什麼。漏了請求或需要批准的項目，就係未覆蓋任務，而唔係單純語法問題。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Data File 寫 Venue: School Hall。錄音說："The hall is unavailable, so the workshop will be in the gym instead." 任務問場地，應寫？
options: A. School Hall
B. The gym
C. School Hall and the gym
D. 一個你自己認為更好的場地
questions.explanation: instead 表示 Hall 已被取代。兩份都寫會自相矛盾。綜合任務要用最新、能完成該項的資料，亦唔好改成資料冇有的場地。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 任務有三個要求。Data File 有七段。最有效的做法是？
options: A. 七段全部改寫進答案
B. 每個要求只留能回答該項的資料，其餘當干擾
C. 只抄第一段
D. 忽略錄音，因為 Data File 較長
questions.explanation: 綜合任務考的是取捨。與三項要求無關、重複或已被錄音更新的句子都要放棄。只抄第一段會漏項；只信較長的文字會漏掉錄音裡的變更。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 按近年公開的英文科評核大綱，卷三只做 Part A 同較易的 B1，該卷最高等級是？
options: A. 沒有上限，同 B2 一樣
B. Level 4
C. Level 2
D. 只計校本評核
questions.explanation: 評核大綱寫明：做 Part A 加 B1 的考生，該卷最高等級是 Level 4；全級距要做 B2。比重或封頂若有修訂，以考評局該年文件為準。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Data File：Fee: $120 per student. 任務要你報告費用。最完整的答案是？
options: B. $120 per student
C. cheap
D. about 100
questions.explanation: 數字要連單位同「每位學生」一齊寫。只寫 120 會漏資料；cheap 同 about 100 都改變了原文。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 組員說 cost is a problem，然後沒有人接話。最好的一句是？
options: A. The weather is nice today.
B. I agree up to a point — the fee is high — and I'd add that we could share the coach cost. What do you think, Jamie?
C. You're wrong.
D. （沉默五秒，然後重複）Cost is a problem.
questions.explanation: 好的承接要有三樣東西：接住費用、加一個新做法、把未發言的組員拉進來。A 離題，C 無禮貌亦冇理由，D 只是重複。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 你不同意，但想保持討論。哪句最合適？
options: A. You're wrong.
B. I'm not so sure, because the hall is already booked.
C. Whatever.
D. I agree with everything. （你其實不同意）
questions.explanation: 客氣反對要用 because 給出理由。A 同 C 破壞互動。D 並沒有表達你的立場，個人內容分亦會空。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 一位組員全程未發言。討論仍在進行。你應該？
options: A. 自己再講多兩分鐘
B. What do you think, Alex?
C. 叫考官更換組員
D. 開始背個人回應的稿
questions.explanation: 交波是小組討論的評分行為。壟斷發言、向考官投訴，或者跳去背稿，都沒有讓該組員加入。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 個人回應、面對考官時，哪句不適合？
options: A. Firstly… Secondly…
B. We haven't heard from you yet.
C. Although the other option is cheaper, I would still choose this one.
D. Let me give one example.
questions.explanation: We haven't heard from you yet 是小組討論的交波句。個人回應要直接給立場、理由同例子，A、C、D 都符合。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: She said, "I am tired." 正確的轉述是？
options: A. She said she is tired.
B. She said she was tired.
C. She said she had tired.
D. She said her was tired.
questions.explanation: said 是過去式，現在式 am 後移為 was。C 的 had tired 並不是 be tired 的過去完成式（應為 had been tired，而這句亦唔需要）。D 的代詞錯誤。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: He says, "I live in Tai Po." 正確是？
options: A. He says he lived in Tai Po.
B. He says he lives in Tai Po.
C. He said he had lived in Tai Po.
D. He says he live in Tai Po.
questions.explanation: 引述動詞 says 是現在式，唔使後移，live 保持現在式，並與 he 一致變成 lives。C 改了引述動詞，D 主謂不一致。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Yesterday she told them, "We will start tomorrow." 正確的轉述是？
options: A. She told them they would start the next day.
B. She told them they will start tomorrow.
C. She told them we will start tomorrow.
D. She told them they would start yesterday.
questions.explanation: told 是過去式：will 後移為 would，tomorrow 改為 the next day，we 改為 they。B 沒有後移。C 保留了 we。D 把 yesterday（說話的時間）錯當成活動時間。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: "Where is the gym?" she asked. 正確是？
options: A. She asked where was the gym.
B. She asked where the gym was.
C. She asked where is the gym.
D. She asked that where the gym was.
questions.explanation: 轉述疑問句要用陳述語序：where the gym was。唔保留倒裝，唔加 that where，亦因為 asked 是過去式而把 is 後移為 was。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: The _____ of the plan depends on funding. 應填？
options: A. succeed
B. success
C. successful
D. successfully
questions.explanation: The 與 of 之間需要名詞，所以是 success。succeed 是動詞，successful 是形容詞，successfully 是副詞。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: economic 同 economical 的分別是？
options: A. 兩個完全同義
B. economic 指與經濟有關；economical 指慳儉、划算
C. economical 只可以形容人的年齡
D. economic 的意思是慳錢
questions.explanation: 兩個都是形容詞，但意思不同。an economic decision 是與經濟有關的決定；an economical decision 是慳儉的決定。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: polite 最常見的反義是？
options: A. unpolite
B. impolite
C. mispolite
D. dispolite
questions.explanation: 唔係每個詞都可以加 un-。polite 的反義是 impolite。自己造 unpolite、mispolite 或 dispolite 都不是標準詞形。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: She completed the work _____.
options: A. success
B. successful
C. successfully
D. succeed
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 completed 要用副詞 successfully。successful 是形容詞，success 是名詞，succeed 是動詞。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 錯題紀錄裡，怎樣先算一個值得主攻的「模式」？
options: A. 任何一題錯了一次
B. 同一錯因至少出現兩次
C. 總分低過五成
D. 只用中文寫原因、不留原句
questions.explanation: 只出現一次的錯先記下，唔好同時開太多戰線。同一錯因重複，先值得成為下一星期的目標。分數本身講唔到錯在哪裡。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 下一星期最合理的改法是？
options: A. 一次過改十種錯
B. 最多攻三個模式，每個寫幾句自己的改寫
C. 把評卷參考整份背下來
D. 只重做最舊的一份卷，不做改寫
questions.explanation: 限制在三個模式，先可以在下一份限時卷核對有冇再犯。背評卷參考或重做舊卷而沒有改句，都唔會顯示哪一個模式消失了。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 你經常把 Data File 整句抄進卷三答案。對治這個模式應該？
options: A. 只做卷二條件句
B. 把同一項資料改寫成任務要求的語氣，而唔係再抄
C. 背多一頁與任務無關的生字
D. 放棄 Part B
questions.explanation: 四卷的錯要分開練。照抄是綜合任務的改寫問題，條件句練習替代不了。改寫時保留數字同單位，改的是句式同語氣。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: 三個模式在下一份限時卷都沒有再出現。下一步是？
options: A. 繼續只練這三個模式
B. 改練下一批重複出現的錯因
C. 停止做卷
D. 把字數加倍，不管任務
questions.explanation: 模式消失就換下一批，否則練習會停在已經解決的問題。停止做卷就看不到新的重複錯誤；加字數亦不是對治方法。
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Passage: “The community kitchen serves dinner from 6:30 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. on weekdays. On public holidays it opens for lunch only, from noon to 2 p.m.” According to the passage, what happens on a public holiday?
options: A. The kitchen serves dinner from 6:30 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.
B. The kitchen serves lunch from noon to 2 p.m. and does not describe a dinner service.
C. The kitchen is closed all day.
D. The kitchen serves both lunch and dinner.
questions.explanation: 定位題要對住時間條件。public holidays 對應 lunch only, noon to 2 p.m.。6:30–8:00 只適用於 weekdays，唔可以搬去假期。原文冇寫全日關閉，亦冇寫假期有晚餐。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: Passage: “Membership rose from 400 to 460.” Which reading of the figure is accurate?
options: A. Membership increased by 60 percent.
B. Membership fell by 60 people.
C. Membership is now 400.
D. Membership increased by 60 people.
questions.explanation: from 400 to 460 係人數由 400 變到 460，增加 60 人，唔係增加 60%。百分比題最常見係把「相差」誤當「百分比」。現時人數係 460，唔係 400。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: A question says “Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a reason for the delay?” You have found three reasons in paragraph 2. What should you do?
options: A. Choose the option that paragraph 2 does not list, even if it sounds sensible.
B. Choose the reason that appears first in the paragraph.
C. Choose the reason that seems most important in real life.
D. Choose any option that uses words from the paragraph.
questions.explanation: NOT / EXCEPT 題係反向定位：三個選項會係原文有的，正確答案係原文冇提到的那項。唔好揀最先出現或聽落最合理的原因，亦唔好因為選項抄了幾個原文字就當佢係答案。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: Passage: “Mina lent her notes to Owen. He returned them the next day with a thank-you card.” What does “them” refer to?
options: A. The thank-you card.
B. Owen’s notes.
C. Mina’s notes.
D. The next day.
questions.explanation: 代詞要向後找最近而文法上合用的名詞。them 係複數，對應 notes，唔係單數的 card，亦唔係時間 next day。Owen 係歸還的人，notes 屬於 Mina。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: A leaflet says “Volunteers must be 16 or above.” A candidate is 16. Which statement matches the leaflet?
options: A. The candidate meets the age requirement.
B. The candidate is too young because the rule means older than 16.
C. Only people under 16 may volunteer.
D. The leaflet does not state an age rule.
questions.explanation: 16 or above 包括 16 歲。too young 會把 or above 讀成 above only。under 16 係相反條件。年齡規定就寫在這一句，唔可以話文章冇講。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: Question: “In which paragraph does the writer first explain how the app saves water?” Paragraph 1 introduces the app, paragraph 3 explains the water-saving steps, and paragraph 4 gives user reviews. Where do you look first?
options: A. Paragraph 1.
B. Paragraph 4.
C. Paragraph 3.
D. The title only.
questions.explanation: 題目問 first explain how。介紹產品的段落通常未解釋方法；用家評價係結果，唔係做法。關鍵動詞 explain 同內容 water-saving steps 對上第 3 段。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: Passage: “Unlike bottled drinks, the school’s filtered water is free.” Which option restates the contrast correctly?
options: A. Bottled drinks and filtered water are both free.
B. Filtered water is more expensive than bottled drinks.
C. The school has stopped providing water.
D. Filtered water costs nothing, whereas bottled drinks do not.
questions.explanation: Unlike 標示對比。free 只形容 filtered water，唔包括 bottled drinks。more expensive 把關係倒轉。原文係有水供應，而且係免費，唔係停止供應。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: An interview transcript: Interviewer: “Who maintains the garden?” Mr Chan: “The residents do. I only buy the tools.” Who maintains the garden?
options: A. Mr Chan.
B. The residents.
C. The interviewer.
D. A contractor hired by Mr Chan.
questions.explanation: 問 who 要對住回答句，唔係對住說話的人。Mr Chan 講 The residents do，自己只買工具。訪問者係提問者。原文冇提到外判承辦商。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: Passage: “The museum is closed on Tuesdays, except during the summer exhibition in July.” A visit is planned for a Tuesday in July, during the exhibition. What does the passage allow?
options: A. The museum is closed every Tuesday of the year, with no exception.
B. The museum is closed for the whole of July.
C. The museum may be open because the Tuesday closure has a July exception.
D. The passage is only about ticket prices.
questions.explanation: except 係例外。平常星期二關閉，但七月展覽期間唔適用。唔可以無視 except，亦唔可以把七月讀成整月關閉。這句講開放日，唔係票價。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: You need two reasons worth 4 marks. The paragraph gives one clear reason and then repeats it with an example. What is the most accurate plan?
options: A. Use the one stated reason, then locate a second, different reason before you write.
B. Write the same reason twice, once as a sentence and once as the example.
C. Copy the whole paragraph as a single answer.
D. Add a reason from your own knowledge so that you have two points.
questions.explanation: 分點計分時，例子通常係支持，唔係第二個獨立理由。同一點寫兩次只計一次。整段照抄冇展示你揀出兩個要點。自己加文章冇講的理由，定位題唔會給分。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: A chart caption reads “Figure 2: Complaints about noise, 2022–2024.” The paragraph below discusses air quality. A question asks what Figure 2 shows. What should you answer from?
options: A. The paragraph about air quality, because it is closer to the question.
B. Both noise and air quality, because they are environmental topics.
C. The title of the whole article only.
D. The caption and the chart, which are about noise complaints.
questions.explanation: 圖表題的答案範圍由 caption 決定。Figure 2 寫明 noise，唔好被旁邊段落的 air quality 帶走。環境呢個大主題唔等於圖表包含所有環境數據。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: Passage: “After the workshop, participants receive a certificate if they attend all three sessions.” Which student should get a certificate?
options: A. A student who attended only the final session.
B. A student who attended session 1, session 2 and session 3.
C. A student who arrived before the workshop began but missed session 2.
D. Every student who signed the registration form.
questions.explanation: 條件係 attend all three sessions，三節都要出席。只出席最後一節、缺第二節，都未滿足 all。報名唔等於出席。after the workshop 只交代派發時間，唔係放寬出席條件。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: Passage: “The writer used to cycle to work. She now takes the ferry.” Which sentence matches the passage?
options: A. She has always taken the ferry.
B. She cycles no longer and travels by ferry instead.
C. She cycles to work and also takes the ferry every day.
D. She has stopped taking the ferry.
questions.explanation: used to 表示過去習慣、而家唔再。now 標示現況係 ferry。always 抹走了改變。both every day 把過去同時當現在。stopped taking the ferry 把現況倒轉。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: Question: “Find a word in paragraph 4 which means ‘not enough of something’.” Paragraph 4 says “Shelter was scarce after the storm.” Which word do you write?
options: A. scarce
B. shelter
C. storm
D. after
questions.explanation: 詞彙定位係找意思相同的一個詞。not enough of something 對 scarce，唔係例子 shelter，亦唔係時間 storm / after。這類題通常要求寫文章原詞，唔好寫同義詞 insufficient 代替。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: An email header shows To: the club secretary; Subject: Room booking for 12 May. The body says the rehearsal moved from 7 p.m. to 5 p.m. A question asks what changed. What changed?
options: A. The recipient of the email.
B. The subject date of 12 May.
C. The rehearsal time.
D. The fact that a room is being booked.
questions.explanation: 正文的 moved from 7 p.m. to 5 p.m. 先係改變。收件人、主題日期、訂房這件事都係背景，題目問 what changed 就要找對比的兩個時間。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: Passage: “Dr Lee argues that the ban helps. A resident quoted in the same paragraph disagrees.” The question is “According to Dr Lee, …”. Whose view must the answer follow?
options: A. The resident’s opposing view.
B. A mixture of both views.
C. The reader’s own view of the ban.
D. Dr Lee’s view that the ban helps.
questions.explanation: According to X 收窄說話者。同一段有相反意見時，只可取 Dr Lee。把兩人混合會變成文章冇講過的第三種立場。閱讀題亦唔係問考生個人意見。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: A heading says “How to store the paint.” The lines under it are “Keep the tin closed. Store it away from sunlight. Do not freeze.” Which line is an instruction in that section?
options: A. Keep the tin closed.
B. The paint was invented in 1998.
C. Customers like the colour.
D. Call the shop to complain about price.
questions.explanation: 小標題限定該節內容。How to store 下面三句都係儲存指示，Keep the tin closed 屬其中一項。發明年份、顧客喜好、投訴價錢都唔喺呢個標題之下，就算出現在文章其他地方都唔係呢題的答案。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: Passage: “Tickets cost $80 for adults and $40 for students. Children under 3 enter free.” How much does one student pay?
options: B. Nothing.
questions.explanation: 要對住身份。student 係 $40，adult 先係 $80。free 只適用 under 3，題目冇話學生未滿 3 歲。$120 係把兩個票價相加，題目問的是 one student。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: You are answering “Give ONE word from paragraph 1 that shows the lab is busy.” Paragraph 1: “The lab was crowded, noisy and brightly lit.” Which choice follows the instruction?
options: A. The lab was crowded, noisy and brightly lit.
B. crowded
C. busy
D. brightly
questions.explanation: 題目要求 paragraph 1 裏面的 ONE word，而且要顯示 busy。crowded 係原詞又合意思。整句違反 one word。busy 係題目用字，唔係段落用字。brightly 形容燈光，唔表示人多。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: Questions 4 and 5 both say “(paragraph 6)”. You cannot find an answer for question 5 in paragraph 6. What is the better next step?
options: A. Jump back to paragraph 1, because later questions often restart the text.
B. Leave question 5 blank and change every earlier answer.
C. Re-read paragraph 6 for a paraphrase, then check the start of paragraph 7 if the form still points there.
D. Answer from general knowledge, since the paragraph number must be a misprint.
questions.explanation: 括號段落係定位範圍。搵唔到時，先檢查同義改寫，而唔係跳回文首。題號大致順序前進，所以下一小步先係段末或下一段開頭。空白同改晒前面答案都太早。閱讀理解唔接受用常識補一段文章冇寫的答案。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — locating explicit detail

questions.question: Passage: “She smiled at the trophy, then put it in a drawer and never mentioned the race again.” What is the best inference?
options: A. She definitely hates sport and will never race again.
B. She may feel uneasy or modest about the win, not simply proud in public.
C. She forgot that she had won a trophy.
D. The drawer is where all school trophies must be kept.
questions.explanation: 推論要貼住兩個動作：笑對獎盃，但收起而且不再提。這可以支持「唔想張揚」或心情複雜，唔可以跳到 definitely hates sport。forgot 與 smiled 矛盾。學校規定收納獎盃係文章冇講的外加設定。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: A review says “The film is flawless if you enjoy three-hour lectures.” What is the tone?
options: A. Entirely sincere praise of an educational film.
B. A neutral summary with no opinion.
C. Anger directed at the audience.
D. Sarcastic: the writer is criticising the film for being long and dull.
questions.explanation: if you enjoy three-hour lectures 係反話。表面讚 flawless，實際把電影比作沉悶長課。完全真心的讚賞會忽略呢個條件句的刺。Neutral 唔成立，因為有評價。對象係電影，唔係怒罵觀眾。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: Passage: “Ben checked his watch every few minutes and answered in short phrases.” What can you reasonably infer?
options: A. Ben seems impatient or eager to leave.
B. Ben is certainly late for a medical appointment.
C. Ben is the most talkative person in the room.
D. Ben has lost his watch.
questions.explanation: 反覆看錶加短句，支持不耐煩或想走。medical appointment 係過度具體，文章冇線索。short phrases 反對 talkative。看錶代表手錶在，唔係弄丟了。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: The writer says “Of course everyone will benefit,” after listing only shop owners who gain from a new road. What is the writer doing?
options: A. Proving with statistics that every resident gains the same amount.
B. Changing the topic to public hospitals.
C. Using irony or overstatement: the claim is wider than the evidence just given.
D. Quoting a law that defines the word everyone.
questions.explanation: 證據只得店主得益，但句子說 everyone。讀者應感到範圍被誇大，這是語氣題而唔係數據證明。文章呢一刻冇轉去醫院，亦冇引用法例定義。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: Passage: “The plan could work, but only if the estate has spare land and the council funds the path.” Which inference is supported?
options: A. Success depends on two conditions that may not both be met.
B. The plan has already succeeded.
C. The plan is impossible and should not be discussed.
D. Spare land is the only thing the plan needs.
questions.explanation: could 加 but only if 表示未成功，而且有兩個必要條件。impossible 太絕對，因為文章留有可行空間。only if 後面有 land 同 funds 兩項，唔可以只留一項。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: A character “laughed, but the laugh did not reach her eyes.” What does the description suggest?
options: A. She is telling a joke that the group enjoys.
B. She has an eye illness.
C. Her amusement is only on the surface.
D. She refuses to speak.
questions.explanation: 笑意不到眼睛，係常見的書面暗示：表面在笑，內心並不。joke 同眼疾都係另加情節。她有笑，所以唔係拒絕發聲。推論題要講情緒，唔好把比喻讀成醫療事實。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: Purpose question: a paragraph lists three prices, then says “Parents should look beyond the cheapest option.” What is the paragraph’s main purpose?
options: A. To prove that the cheapest option is always dangerous.
B. To give a biography of one parent.
C. To explain how coins are manufactured.
D. To warn parents not to choose on price alone.
questions.explanation: 目的題要概括全段功能。價格例子服務最後的建議：唔好只看最平。always dangerous 把建議升級成文章冇講的絕對結論。傳記同造幣都唔係呢段在做的事。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: The writer calls a new rule “a plaster on a broken leg.” What attitude does the image show?
options: A. The writer is giving medical advice about fractures.
B. The rule is too small for a serious problem.
C. The rule will fully solve the problem.
D. The writer has no opinion about the rule.
questions.explanation: plaster on a broken leg 係比喻：細小的處理對不上嚴重傷勢。唔好當字面醫療建議。fully solve 與比喻相反。有比喻就有態度，唔係中立。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: Passage: “I don’t mind staying late,” she said, already packing her bag. Which reading fits both parts?
options: A. She is happy to stay late, as her words prove by themselves.
B. She has lost her bag and cannot leave.
C. Her words and actions conflict; she seems unwilling to stay.
D. She is arriving at work for the first time.
questions.explanation: 言語同動作一齊讀。packing her bag 顯示準備離開，所以 don’t mind 不可單獨當真心。lost her bag 同 packing 不符。packing to leave 唔係第一天上班。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: A writer says “Some studies suggest a link. That is not the same as proof.” What should a reader infer about the writer’s standard of evidence?
options: A. The writer refuses to treat a possible link as a settled fact.
B. The writer believes the link has been proved.
C. The writer thinks all studies are useless.
D. The writer is changing the subject to sport.
questions.explanation: suggest 同 proof 被刻意分開。作者的立場係證據未足夠，唔係已經證明，亦唔係否定所有研究。呢句冇轉去運動話題。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: Which inference is too strong for the sentence “A few shops on the street have closed this year”?
options: A. At least some shops on that street are no longer open.
B. The closures happened this year, not ten years ago.
C. The sentence is about shops, not schools.
D. The whole district’s economy has collapsed.
questions.explanation: a few 同 this year 只支持少量店舖在今年結業。whole district collapsed 把範圍同嚴重程度都放大，係過度推論。其餘三項都係句子直接包含的意思，唔算推論過頭。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: Passage: “He thanked the team, although he had done most of the work himself.” What can you say about his manner?
options: A. He is accusing the team of doing nothing, in public.
B. He is presenting the success as shared, whatever the actual workload.
C. He did none of the work.
D. The team refused to attend.
questions.explanation: thanked 顯示公開態度係歸功團隊；although 補充實際工作量主要是他。這係謙遜或顧及團隊，唔係公開指責。did none 與 most of the work himself 矛盾。出席與否文章冇講。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: A column ends “Readers may decide whether that is leadership.” The writer has just described a principal who cancelled a consultation. What is the effect of the last sentence?
options: A. It states that the principal is legally forbidden from leading.
B. It invites readers to judge, while signalling doubt about the principal’s approach.
C. It introduces a new story about a different school.
D. It gives the consultation dates.
questions.explanation: may decide 把判斷交給讀者，但放在取消諮詢之後，語氣係質疑而唔係中性資料。法律禁止、另一間學校、諮詢日期都唔係這句在做的事。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: Two sentences: “The hall was full. Dozens of people were turned away.” What follows?
options: A. Demand was higher than the number of seats.
B. The event was cancelled because nobody came.
C. The hall has unlimited space.
D. People were turned away for being late only, and seats remained empty.
questions.explanation: full 加 turned away 支持座位不足。nobody came 與 full 矛盾。unlimited space 與被拒諸門外矛盾。文章冇講遲到，亦冇講仍有空位。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: The narrator says “We were fine,” then describes wet shoes, a missed bus and a two-hour walk. Why is “fine” unreliable?
options: A. The word fine always means excellent weather.
B. A narrator’s first sentence must be ignored in every text.
C. The later details show the situation was difficult, so “fine” is understatement.
D. The details prove they arrived early and dry.
questions.explanation: 語氣題要看下文是否推翻或削弱前文。濕鞋、錯過巴士、行兩小時顯示並不好過，fine 係輕描淡寫。fine 喺呢度唔係天氣預報。第一句唔係永遠作廢，而係要同細節一齊讀。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: Which statement is an inference rather than a stated fact, given “The coach praised Ada and left Kai’s name off the list”?
options: A. The coach praised Ada.
B. Kai’s name was not on the list.
C. Ada and Kai are both mentioned in connection with the coach’s decision.
D. Kai may have been less satisfied with the selection than Ada.
questions.explanation: 事實題可以指回原文動作。Kai 的心情文章冇直接寫，只能由「被讚」同「名單冇名」推。把推論寫成事實，或者把事實誤當深層推論，都係這類題的失分點。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: A leaflet’s slogan is “Sleep less. Achieve more.” The article then describes students who became ill. How should you read the slogan?
options: A. As a claim the article is likely questioning, because the illness examples work against it.
B. As medical advice the article fully supports.
C. As a set of sleeping times to memorise.
D. As a statement about school bus routes.
questions.explanation: 口號同後文生病的例子方向相反，所以口號多半係被批評的對象。fully supports 忽略了反證。口號冇給出睡眠時數，亦與校巴路線無關。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: “She corrected him once, then let the error stand.” What is a fair inference about her priority at that moment?
options: A. She did not notice any error.
B. She agrees that the error is factually correct.
C. She left the room before he spoke.
D. She chose not to keep interrupting, even though she noticed the error.
questions.explanation: corrected once 證明她留意到錯誤；let it stand 證明她其後選擇唔再追究。agrees 與 corrected 矛盾。left the room 係原文冇有的動作。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: The phrase “a so-called improvement” suggests the writer…
options: A. has measured the improvement and confirmed it.
B. doubts that the change is really an improvement.
C. is defining the word improvement for a dictionary.
D. is thanking the organisers without reservation.
questions.explanation: so-called 表示名不副實，係懷疑語氣。confirmed 會用數據或 clearly，唔會用 so-called。字典定義同毫無保留的致謝都讀唔出懷疑。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: A question asks what the writer implies about tourists. The text says locals “pick up the litter visitors leave behind.” Which answer stays inside the implication?
options: A. Every tourist in the city breaks the law.
B. Locals prefer litter and ask visitors to leave more.
C. Some visitors create extra work for locals.
D. The writer is only describing a recycling factory.
questions.explanation: leave behind 加 locals pick up 支持「部分遊客造成額外工作」。every tourist 同 breaks the law 都超出文本。prefer litter 把責任方向倒轉。回收廠係另加場景。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Reading — inference and tone

questions.question: You are writing a formal letter to a company you do not know personally. Which opening is appropriate?
options: A. Hey team!!
B. Dear Sir or Madam,
C. To whom it may love,
D. Hi buddy,
questions.explanation: 未知收件人的正式信可用 Dear Sir or Madam，之後用 Yours faithfully。Hey / Hi buddy 係同輩口語。To whom it may love 係錯誤套語，正式套語係 To whom it may concern，但現代表達更常用 Dear Sir or Madam。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — text-type conventions

questions.question: A proposal for the school principal should mainly…
options: A. tell a personal story with no requested action.
B. review a film the principal may enjoy.
C. list jokes to make the tone friendly.
D. state the problem, the proposed action, the cost or effort, and the expected benefit.
questions.explanation: Proposal 的任務係說服決策者採取行動。問題、做法、代價、好處係評分時容易找到的內容點。純故事、影評同笑話都冇完成「建議」這個文體任務。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — text-type conventions

questions.question: Which feature belongs to an article for a school magazine, rather than to an internal email?
options: A. A title and paragraphs that a general student reader can follow without knowing a private thread.
B. A subject line such as “Re: tomorrow’s meeting”.
C. Cc and attachment references as the main content.
D. One-line replies that assume the reader saw the previous email.
questions.explanation: Article 要有標題，而且讀者係公開的學生，唔可以假設對方讀過私人電郵來往。Subject、Cc、Re 都係電郵格式。文體錯配會同時失內容同語域分。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — text-type conventions

questions.question: You must write a speech. Which opening shows that you understand the text type?
options: A. Dear Editor,
B. To: All staff. From: The prefects.
C. Good morning, teachers and students. Today I want to talk about…
D. Once upon a time in a kingdom far away…
questions.explanation: Speech 要有口語的稱呼同聽眾意識。Dear Editor 係投書。To/From 係備忘錄或電郵。Once upon a time 係故事開場，除非題目要求講故事，否則會離題。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — text-type conventions

questions.question: A one-sided argumentative essay asks “Should the school ban mobile phones?” What must the whole piece do?
options: A. Take one clear side and develop reasons for that side.
B. Describe a school day without giving a view.
C. Give equal space to both sides and refuse to choose.
D. Write a letter of complaint about a single teacher.
questions.explanation: One-sided 要求整篇站一邊。只描述、或兩邊同樣長而不表態，都未完成題目的 should。投訴一位老師把題目收窄到文章冇要求的個案，屬離題。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — text-type conventions

questions.question: In a formal report, which heading is useful?
options: A. LOL moments
B. My feelings at midnight
C. Recommendations
D. Once upon a heading
questions.explanation: Report 用功能小標題幫助讀者找到資料同建議。Recommendations 係常見而且合任務的標題。玩笑標題同私人感受標題會破壞正式報告的語域。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — text-type conventions

questions.question: You are writing an email to a classmate about a group project. Which sentence matches the relationship?
options: A. I hereby demand your immediate compliance with the aforesaid request.
B. To whom it may concern: the undersigned awaits your slides.
C. Yours faithfully, a concerned citizen.
D. Could you send me your slides before Friday?
questions.explanation: 同學之間用禮貌但直接的請求。hereby、aforesaid、undersigned、concerned citizen 都係過正式或錯誤身份，會被當成語域不當。合身份比堆砌深字更重要。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — text-type conventions

questions.question: A blog post for teenagers about study habits should…
options: A. copy the layout of a balance sheet.
B. use a conversational but clear voice, with concrete tips the reader can try.
C. address the reader as “Esteemed shareholder”.
D. avoid paragraphs so that it looks like a text message with no structure.
questions.explanation: Blog 可以口語，但仍然要分段同給具體建議。資產負債表係另一文體。shareholder 係錯讀者。完全冇段落會損害組織分，即使語氣年輕。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — text-type conventions

questions.question: Which closing fits a formal letter that began “Dear Ms Chan,”?
options: A. Yours faithfully,
B. Cheers mate,
C. Yours sincerely,
D. XOXO
questions.explanation: 英式正式信：稱呼裏有姓名（Dear Ms Chan）用 Yours sincerely；未知姓名（Dear Sir or Madam）先用 Yours faithfully。Cheers mate 同 XOXO 只適合非常親密的私人訊息。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — text-type conventions

questions.question: The question asks for a letter to the editor. You write a speech script with “Good evening, everyone.” What is the main problem?
options: A. The text type does not match the task, so content points tied to a letter are missed.
B. Speeches are always longer, so the extra length will raise the mark.
C. Letters and speeches are scored in exactly the same way if the opinion is clear.
D. An editor cannot be addressed, so any format is acceptable.
questions.explanation: 文體係任務的一部分。寫成演講會缺少投書的讀者意識（編輯與公眾讀者）同書信格式。長短本身唔會自動加分。意見清楚亦補唔返文體錯誤。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — text-type conventions

questions.question: Where should the main request appear in a formal letter of request?
options: A. Only in a postscript after the signature.
B. Nowhere: the reader should guess the request from adjectives.
C. In the first sentence, with no context and no polite framing.
D. Early, after a short purpose statement, and again briefly before the closing.
questions.explanation: 請求信要讓收件人很快知道你想要什麼，所以目的句宜早，結尾再禮貌重申。只放在 P.S. 容易被忽略。完全不寫請求就未完成任務。第一句冇上下文又無禮貌，會影響語氣分。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — text-type conventions

questions.question: You have 40 minutes left for a 400-word piece. What is a sound use of the first 5 minutes?
options: A. Write a full draft in your head and put nothing on the page until minute 35.
B. Decide the text type, the audience and three content points, then start writing.
C. Spend the time decorating the title with different handwriting styles.
D. Change the question to a text type you memorised last year.
questions.explanation: 短時間內，計畫要服務動筆：文體、讀者、三個內容點就夠。在腦內寫完整篇會令你來不及落筆。裝飾標題唔得分。背誦舊文體而改題，係嚴重離題。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — text-type conventions

questions.question: Which sentence can work as a topic sentence for a paragraph arguing for later school start times?
options: A. Many schools open at 8 a.m.
B. A later start would give teenagers the sleep they need to concentrate.
C. I walked to school yesterday.
D. Sleep is a word with five letters.
questions.explanation: 主題句要有可辯護的主張。later start 連到 concentrate，後面可以加原因同例子。開門時間、個人走路、字母數目都係事實或空話，帶不起一段論證。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — argument and language

questions.question: You want one paragraph to answer the objection “Students will only stay up later.” Which move is best?
options: A. Insult people who raise the objection.
B. Ignore the objection so the essay looks shorter.
C. Agree with the objection and abandon your thesis without saying so.
D. State the objection fairly, then explain why a fixed timetable and parent or school follow-up can limit that effect.
questions.explanation: 反駁段要先公平複述對方，再給限制條件或證據。人身攻擊唔算論證。完全不理會反對意見，說服力會弱。暗中放棄立場會令全文自相矛盾。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — argument and language

questions.question: Which paragraph order best supports a one-sided essay?
options: A. Thesis, strongest reason with an example, second reason, brief answer to one objection, then a restated position.
B. A new story in every sentence with no repeated position.
C. The conclusion in sentence 1 and no reasons afterwards.
D. Three examples of the same reason presented as three different reasons.
questions.explanation: 單邊文章仍然需要推進：立場、理由、例子、處理一個反對、收束。只有故事、或只有結論，都發展不足。同一理由換例子三次，內容分通常只當一個點。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — argument and language

questions.question: Which connective honestly introduces a contrast?
options: A. Therefore, the cost is higher than the club can afford.
B. For example, the cost is higher than the club can afford.
C. However, the cost is higher than the club can afford.
D. In addition, the cost is higher than the club can afford, after a sentence that already said the plan is too expensive.
questions.explanation: However 先係轉折。Therefore 表示結果，For example 表示例子，用錯會讓邏輯關係相反。In addition 用來自重複同一個缺點，會顯得沒有新資訊。連接詞要跟句子之間的真實關係。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — argument and language

questions.question: A reason says “Uniforms are good because they are good for students.” What is missing?
options: A. A specific explanation of how uniforms help, such as reducing clothing pressure.
B. A second copy of the same sentence in capital letters.
C. A quotation from a song with no link to school.
D. Three exclamation marks.
questions.explanation: because they are good 係循環論證，冇解釋機制。評分看的是發展：點樣幫助、對誰、在什麼情況。放大字體、無關歌詞同感嘆號都唔代替理由。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — argument and language

questions.question: Which example is specific enough to support “School sports reduce stress”?
options: A. Sports are popular around the world.
B. Stress is bad.
C. After basketball training, students in one class reported sleeping earlier on practice nights.
D. Everyone knows this is true.
questions.explanation: 例子要有情境同可觀察的結果，先連接得到 reduce stress。全世界流行、壓力不好、everyone knows 都係空泛句，冇支持這一個主張。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — argument and language

questions.question: You are aiming at a formal argument. Which wording is the best match?
options: A. It’s kinda messed up that prefect stuff is so random lol.
B. The aforesaid individual aforementioned should do the thing.
C. Prefects prefects prefects — repetition creates truth.
D. The school should publish the criteria it uses to choose prefects.
questions.explanation: 正式論證要清楚、具體、語氣穩定。口語 lol 損害語域。堆砌 aforesaid 但冇實質動詞，係假正式。重複詞語唔構成論點。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — argument and language

questions.question: Your thesis is “The library should stay open on Sundays.” Which body sentence supports it directly?
options: A. Libraries were invented long ago.
B. Many students revise there because their homes are noisy at weekends.
C. Sunday is the first day or the seventh day, depending on the calendar.
D. I dislike Monday mornings.
questions.explanation: 支持句要解釋為什麼星期日開放有需要。家中嘈雜、需要溫習，直接服務論點。歷史、曆法同星期一心情都係離題細節。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — argument and language

questions.question: Which conclusion restates a position without adding a brand-new reason?
options: A. A further point, not mentioned above, is that the roof must be replaced next week.
B. I forgot to say what I think.
C. For these reasons, the school should keep the Sunday hours.
D. In conclusion, bananas are yellow.
questions.explanation: 結尾負責收束已寫的理由，唔好突然加一個未解釋的新論點。未表態等於冇結論。香蕉與圖書館開放無關。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — argument and language

questions.question: You quote a number: “About 30 students in our survey preferred quiet rooms.” What must you still do?
options: A. Explain how that number supports the point you are making.
B. Assume any number is persuasive by itself.
C. Change 30 to 30,000 so the paragraph looks stronger.
D. Hide the fact that it was a small survey.
questions.explanation: 數字要被解釋：30 人相對什麼整體、支持哪一個主張。數字本身唔等於論證。誇大數字係不誠實，亦會破壞說服力。小調查可以作校本例子，但應如實說明範圍。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — argument and language

questions.question: Which sentence uses a hedge that is precise rather than empty?
options: A. It might maybe possibly be somewhat good in some ways.
B. This will definitely solve every school problem forever.
C. Everyone always agrees with this.
D. The change may help Form 6 students during mock-exam weeks, when sleep loss is common.
questions.explanation: 有效的限定語會指出對象同情境。一串 maybe 冇資訊。definitely forever 同 everyone always 係過度絕對，論證題裏好容易被攻破。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — argument and language

questions.question: A paragraph starts with a reason about cost, then gives an example about friendship, then ends with a sentence about climate. What should you fix first?
options: A. Add more unrelated topics so the paragraph looks longer.
B. Keep one controlling idea and move unrelated examples to other paragraphs or cut them.
C. Remove the topic sentence and hope the reader finds a theme.
D. Repeat the word important in every sentence.
questions.explanation: 一段一個中心。成本、友情、氣候如果沒有明確關係，讀者睇唔到發展。加長、刪主題句、重複 important 都唔解決統一性。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Writing — argument and language

questions.question: The recording says “The fee is $200… sorry, $220, including materials.” What should your note say?
options: B. $220, including materials.
D. The fee was cancelled.
questions.explanation: 說話人自我更正時，採用更正後的資料。$200 係被收回的數字。$20 係兩個數字相減，錄音冇這個計算。sorry 係更正，唔係取消收費。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: A task says “Write a short email to parents. Use information from the Data File and the recording.” Which source may you ignore?
options: A. The Data File, because listening marks only come from the recording.
B. The recording, because integrated tasks only copy the Data File.
C. Both, if you already know what parents like to hear.
D. Neither: both sources can contain required points.
questions.explanation: 綜合卷的內容點可以分布在錄音同 Data File。只聽不看、或只看不聽，都會漏點。用自己對家長的印象取代資料，係離題。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: You hear “Don’t include the old gym. We’re only talking about the new hall.” A later task asks for venues to mention. What do you include?
options: A. The new hall only.
B. The old gym only.
C. Both the old gym and the new hall.
D. Every sports venue you can think of.
questions.explanation: Don’t include 係明確排除。筆記要寫下限制，唔好因為舊館曾被提到就當它是內容點。亦不可自行加入錄音冇講的場地。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: The instruction page says the reader is the chairperson of the parent group. How should the email sound?
options: A. Like a text to a close friend, with slang and no greeting.
B. Like a diary entry written to yourself.
C. Polite and semi-formal, with a clear request or report for that chairperson.
D. Like a scientific paper with no reference to the parent group.
questions.explanation: 綜合任務的語域由讀者身份決定。家長會主席需要禮貌、清楚的電郵。朋友短訊、日記同無關的論文腔都係錯讀者。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: A speaker says “We’ll meet on the twelfth, not the twentieth.” Which note is safe?
options: A. Meeting date: 12th (not 20th).
B. Meeting date: 20th.
C. Meeting date: 12th or 20th.
D. No date was given.
questions.explanation: not 後面係干擾項。安全筆記會同時記下正確日期同被否定的日期，避免稍後寫文時揀錯。or 把排除變成選擇。話冇日期係忽略了 twelfth。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: The Data File has a poster with the slogan “Fun for all!” The recording says the event is for Form 4 only. The task says “Follow the recording if sources disagree.” What do you write?
options: A. The event is for everyone, because the poster is more colourful.
B. Both “everyone” and “Form 4 only” in the same sentence.
C. The event is for Form 4 only.
D. Nothing about the audience.
questions.explanation: 任務若寫明資料衝突時以錄音為準，就要服從錄音。海報口號唔可以蓋過明確限制。兩個互相矛盾的對象放在同一句，會令內容點錯誤。漏寫對象通常會失一個內容點。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: Which note-taking symbol is useful while the recording is still playing?
options: A. A brand-new code you invent for every word and cannot reread.
B. Full sentences copied in perfect handwriting.
C. Nothing until the recording ends.
D. A short form you already understand, such as “→” for “leads to”.
questions.explanation: 筆記要快而且稍後自己讀得明。穩定簡寫有用。每詞新密碼會在寫作時失效。錄音進行中追求完整句子，通常會漏後面的重點。等到結束先寫，短期記憶唔夠。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: The task says “about 120 words”. You have five content points. What is a sensible plan?
options: A. Write 400 words so that more language marks are guaranteed.
B. Give each point one clear sentence and cut greetings down to one line.
C. Use the whole word limit on the greeting and sign-off.
D. Omit three content points to keep the paragraphs stylish.
questions.explanation: 字數大約值係為了裝下內容點。五點各一句，加上簡短開頭結尾，先接近 120 字。大幅超額唔會自動加語言分，而且可能寫不完。把字數花在格式套語、或丟掉內容點，都會失內容分。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: You hear a name: “Ms Rajesh — that’s R-A-J-E-S-H.” Why does the speaker spell it?
options: A. Spelling never matters in integrated tasks.
B. You should replace the name with “the teacher” to be safe.
C. The spelling is likely to be marked, so the note should keep those letters.
D. The letters are a secret code for the fee.
questions.explanation: 錄音若逐字母串名字，通常這個拼寫就是內容。改成 the teacher 會失去專有名詞。字母串係姓名，唔係費用密碼。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: A speaker lists “first… second… and, most importantly, …” Which item should you mark as the priority in a proposal?
options: A. The item introduced by “most importantly”.
B. Only the first item, because lists always rank that way.
C. None of them, because spoken emphasis is irrelevant.
D. A fourth item you add yourself.
