questions.explanation: most importantly 係說話人自己的排序，寫建議時應突出該項。first 只表示順序，唔一定是最重要。口語強調往往就是內容點。自行加第四項冇文本根據。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: The Data File includes a table: Workshop A, 4 p.m., Room 2. The recording does not mention rooms. The email must tell students where to go. What do you use?
options: A. No room, because the recording never said one.
B. Room 4, by combining the time and the letter A.
C. Any empty room in the school.
D. Room 2, from the Data File.
questions.explanation: 地點只出現在 Data File 時，仍然要採用，因為任務要求告訴學生去哪裏。錄音冇提到唔等於資料不存在。把 4 p.m. 同 A 合成 Room 4 係誤讀表格。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: Which piece of language best paraphrases a note that says “bring own water”?
options: A. bring own water
B. Please bring a bottle of water with you.
C. The school will provide water for everyone.
D. Do not bring any drinks, including water.
questions.explanation: 綜合寫作通常要求改寫筆記，而唔係貼上電報式短語。意思要保持：自備水。學校供應、以及禁止帶水，都與筆記相反。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: You missed one number while listening. The Data File later shows the same figure in a budget table. What should you do before you write?
options: A. Invent a round number so the sentence looks complete.
B. Check the table and use it if the task allows that source.
C. Leave every later task blank.
D. Assume missed numbers are never tested.
questions.explanation: 漏聽可以靠 Data File 補，這正是綜合卷的設計。捏造數字會錯內容點。一個數字漏聽唔使放棄其後所有任務。數字經常是給分點，唔好假設唔考。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: The speaker says “I’m not against the trip. I’m against holding it on a school day.” What is the opinion?
options: A. The speaker accepts the trip but objects to the timing.
B. The speaker rejects all trips.
C. The speaker wants the trip on a school day.
D. The speaker has no opinion.
questions.explanation: not against A, against B 要拆開兩個對象。行程本身被接受，反對的是上學日舉行。把反對擴展到所有行程，或把時間讀反，都係聽力裏的範圍錯誤。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: A task says “Write in bullet points.” You write one long narrative paragraph. What is the risk?
options: A. Bullet points are only a suggestion and never affect the mark.
B. A paragraph always scores higher than bullets for the same points.
C. You may lose organisation marks and make content points harder to find.
D. The instruction applies only to the recording, not to your answer.
questions.explanation: 文體指示包括段落形式。要求 bullet 時，長篇敘事會讓評卷者較難點算內容，亦可能不符任務。指示係對考生答案，唔係對錄音。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: Two students are speaking. Pat says the rehearsal is on Thursday. Kim says “No, the teacher moved it to Friday.” The chairperson then says “Yes, Friday it is.” Which day do you record?
options: A. Thursday.
B. Thursday and Friday.
C. No rehearsal.
D. Friday, because the correction is confirmed.
questions.explanation: 後說話者更正，而且主席確認 Friday。小組討論裏要跟隨被確認的版本，唔好停留在第一個被否定的日子，亦唔好把兩個日子都寫成正確。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: Which note separates fact from a suggestion?
options: A. Fact: hall booked 6–8. Suggestion (Jo): start at 6:15 so people can arrive.
B. Start at 6:15 because the booking says so.
C. Hall booked 6:15–8.
D. No difference: suggestions and bookings are the same kind of information.
questions.explanation: 訂場時間係事實，6:15 只是 Jo 的建議。寫作時如果任務問「已決定的安排」，就只能用 6–8。把建議寫成已預訂，係綜合卷常見的資料類型錯誤。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: The recording gives the reason, and the Data File gives the email address of the recipient. A complete answer needs…
options: A. the reason only, because addresses are decoration.
B. the address only, because reasons are optional.
C. a different address that you use in real life.
D. the reason in the body and the correct address in the header if the task provides a header.
questions.explanation: 格式資料同內容理由可以各佔分數。題目提供抬頭時，收件資料要準。只寫其中一項會漏分。不可換成自己生活中的電郵地址。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: You hear “roughly fifty, maybe a few more.” The task says “Do not invent an exact figure.” How should you write it?
options: A. Exactly 50 students.
B. About 50 students.
C. Exactly 53 students.
D. 500 students.
questions.explanation: roughly / maybe 表示大約。About 50 保留不確定。Exactly 50 或 53 都把估計寫成精確事實。500 係聽錯位數。任務禁止捏造精確數字時，更要用約數。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: Before the recording starts, what is the highest-value use of the preparation time?
options: A. Memorise a model email that may not match the tasks.
B. Skip the Data File headings until the recording is over.
C. Read the tasks and underline who you are writing to and what text type each task requires.
D. Practise spelling your own name.
questions.explanation: 備考時間要用來知道等一下聽什麼、寫給誰、哪一種文體。背模文會令你硬套錯任務。Data File 的小標題能預測內容點，唔應該留到最後。自己的姓名通常唔係得分點。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Listening and Integrated Skills — note-taking

questions.question: In a group discussion, you have not spoken for a minute. What is a useful move?
options: A. Stay silent so that stronger candidates can take your marks.
B. Add a short point and then invite another candidate in: “What do you think, Alex?”
C. Interrupt and repeat your prepared speech from the start.
D. Change the topic to something you memorised.
questions.explanation: 小組討論看互動，唔只看長篇獨白。沉默會令你冇語言樣本。把背誦稿從頭講會無視討論進程。轉到無關題目會離題。短點加邀請，同時展示內容同溝通策略。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — group interaction

questions.question: A partner says something you disagree with. Which response keeps the discussion going?
options: A. “That’s stupid.”
B. Silence, then a new topic.
C. “I agree” — even though you do not — followed by no reason.
D. “I see your point about cost, but I’m worried about safety because…”
questions.explanation: 不同意都要先承接對方要點，再給理由。人身攻擊會破壞互動分。沉默轉題等於冇回應。假同意又冇理由，討論不會推進。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — group interaction

questions.question: You did not hear a teammate’s suggestion. What should you say?
options: A. “Sorry, could you say that again? I want to respond to your idea.”
B. Pretend you heard and argue against a different idea.
C. Ask the examiner to restart the whole exam.
D. Say nothing and hope the individual response will save you.
questions.explanation: 要求重複係允許的溝通策略，而且顯示你想回應。假裝聽見會答非所問。小組討論通常唔會因為一句沒聽清就重考。把全部分數押在個人短講，會浪費討論部分。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — group interaction

questions.question: The individual response asks for your own opinion on the group’s idea. What structure is enough in the short time?
options: A. Retell the entire group discussion word for word.
B. List ten reasons with no example and no ending.
C. State your view, give one reason, and add one concrete example.
D. Say “I don’t know” and stop.
questions.explanation: 個人回應時間短，一個立場、一個理由、一個例子就已經完整。複述全組討論會冇時間給自己的看法。理由太多而冇例子，發展會淺。I don’t know 就結束，幾乎冇語言產出。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — individual response

questions.question: Which habit helps pronunciation marks without changing your ideas?
options: A. Finishing key words instead of swallowing the ends of sentences.
B. Speaking as fast as possible to show fluency.
C. Replacing every difficult word with “thing”.
D. Reading a script in a flat voice with no pauses.
questions.explanation: 清楚說完關鍵詞，考官先聽得到語音同內容。過快會令音節消失。所有名詞變成 thing 會同時損害詞彙分。平讀稿件唔像討論，亦欠缺自然停頓。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — group interaction

questions.question: One candidate is talking without stopping. What is a fair interruption?
options: A. Talking over them until they give up.
B. Leaving the room to show disagreement.
C. “Can I add something here? Another option is…”
D. Whispering to the examiner that the candidate should stop.
questions.explanation: 禮貌切入可以拿回話輪，而且提供新內容。一直蓋過對方會兩人都聽不清。離場同向考官投訴都唔係討論策略，亦可能被視為無禮。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — group interaction

questions.question: You are summarising before the discussion ends. Which summary is useful?
options: A. “So… yeah.”
B. A summary that adds a new plan nobody discussed and presents it as the group’s decision.
C. A summary in a language other than English.
D. “So we have two ideas: a shorter camp, and a day camp if the budget is tight.”
questions.explanation: 總結要準確複述已出現的選擇。So… yeah 冇內容。把未經討論的方案說成小組決定，係不準確。口試要使用英語，轉語言唔會得分。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — group interaction

questions.question: Which question invites a quiet candidate without taking over their answer?
options: A. “Mei, say yes or no, and then I’ll continue my speech.”
B. “Mei, you mentioned safety earlier. Do you think the day camp solves that?”
C. “Why are you so quiet? It’s awkward.”
D. Asking three long questions before Mei can speak.
questions.explanation: 好的邀請會引用對方曾講過的點，並問一個可以回答的問題。逼對方只說 yes、取笑沉默、或一次問太多，都唔係真正把話輪交出去。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — group interaction

questions.question: The discussion topic is school uniforms. You prepared only about canteen food. What should you do?
options: A. Deliver the canteen speech anyway, because it is fluent.
B. Refuse to speak until the topic changes.
C. Drop the memorised canteen talk and respond to uniforms with a simple, honest point.
D. Ask the group to abandon the exam topic.
questions.explanation: 離題的流利背誦仍然離題。口試可以很簡單，但要扣住當前題目。拒絕發言或要求改題，都會失去互動分。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — group interaction

questions.question: Which phrase gives a reason, not just a preference?
options: A. “I’d choose the morning slot because more volunteers are free before lunch.”
B. “Morning. Just morning.”
C. “Because because because.”
D. “I choose it for no reason.”
questions.explanation: because 後面要有具體原因，先算發展。只重複選項、空喊 because、或承認冇理由，都讓考官聽不到論證。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — individual response

questions.question: You need a word you cannot remember. Which strategy keeps you in English?
options: A. Stop the exam and ask for a dictionary.
B. Switch to another language for the rest of the turn.
C. Say the word’s first letter over and over.
D. Paraphrase: “the machine that shows whether an email is real”.
questions.explanation: 釋義係口試允許的策略，而且仍然展示英語。口試進行中通常不可查詞典。轉語言同重複字母都冇完成表達。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — group interaction

questions.question: Body language can support delivery. Which choice matches a speaking exam?
options: A. Stare only at your notes for the full eight minutes.
B. Look at the candidates you are answering, and glance at the examiner naturally.
C. Turn your back so that you can concentrate.
D. Keep your hand over your mouth to hide nerves.
questions.explanation: 眼神顯示你在同人討論。全程看筆記會像讀稿。轉身同掩嘴都會令聲音同互動變差。身體語言係輔助，重點仍然是聽得見的英語。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — group interaction

questions.question: The examiner asks a follow-up you did not expect. What is the best first sentence?
options: A. “That was not in my plan.”
B. “That’s a good question. I think… because…”
C. “Please repeat the original topic and not this question.”
D. Silence until the examiner moves on.
questions.explanation: 跟進問題本來就可能在計畫之外。先接住問題，再給一個理由，比宣布自己沒準備好更有用。要求考官撤回問題、或保持沉默，都唔會產生分數。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — individual response

questions.question: Which contribution moves the group forward instead of repeating it?
options: A. “We agree on a day camp. The open question is whether to charge a fee.”
B. Repeating the first speaker’s sentence with the same example.
C. Voting by shouting “day camp” five times.
D. Asking “What are we talking about?” after several minutes of clear discussion.
questions.explanation: 推進係指出已同意的部分同未決定的部分。重複第一位同學的句子冇新資訊。喊口號唔係討論。討論已經清楚時再問題目，會顯得沒有聆聽。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — group interaction

questions.question: You want to show that you were listening. Which phrase does that?
options: A. “Anyway, my next point, which I prepared, is…”
B. “I wasn’t listening, but I have an idea.”
C. “You said the evening class clashes with training. What if we move it to Saturday morning?”
D. “Let me read my notes to the examiner.”
questions.explanation: 引用對方剛剛的衝突，再提出替代，係聆聽的證據。Anyway 加背稿會切斷對話。承認沒聽就繼續講，互動分會低。把筆記讀給考官，忽略了小組成員。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — group interaction

questions.question: Time is almost up and the group has three unfinished ideas. What should you do?
options: A. Introduce a fourth idea.
B. Spend the last minute apologising for your accent.
C. Stop in the middle of a word and leave the choice unspoken.
D. Propose one idea to keep and say why, so the discussion ends with a choice.
questions.explanation: 最後一分鐘適合收束：揀一個方案並給原因。新點子來不及討論。為口音道歉唔提供內容，口音本身亦唔係你該在答案裏評論的重點。說到一半停止，會浪費一個可以完整的句子。
questions.subject: english
questions.syllabus_ref: HKDSE English Speaking — group interaction
